title: The 6:20 Ferry
author: Wren Alder
summary: The cheapest wildlife tour in Washington costs less than a sandwich.
content:
Twice a month I take the first boat across the Sound with a thermos and no plan. From the water, a city behaves like a coastline: it has a tide of commuters, a weather of its own and birds that know the timetable.

It's also a good way to stay sharp between jobs. You get one crossing, the light won't wait and there's no walking closer.
